profile.subtitleJa: ツィクラグというダビデが滞在した町
profile.summaryJa: サムエル記下1:1で、ダビデはサウルの死後、ツィクラグに二日滞在していたと記されます。ここでは彼の滞在地として現れる町名を扱います。

facts.textJa: 4:10でも同じ地名が本文に現れる。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,
when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.
